user_query: Identify this protein and elucidate its enzyme catalytic activity, especially the chemical reaction, using sequence homologs and curated annotations. Distinguish direct curated evidence from homology inference.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.
